rv.q: Together, Bryggman and Parker hit enough emotional highs to sustain a dozen lesser plays.
But their offstage excesses arehardly enoughto convince us sceptics that Proof isn't a vastly overrated play.

It's been a long time since Broadway has seen the debut of a new play the quality of Proof, and even longer since it has welcomed the debut of a new playwright as talented and promising as David Auburn.
Neither will David Auburn’s light but smart play.
Auburn's slight but vibrating piece... is good to report that her reputation as a serious actress remains enhanced by this performance.

"Proof" is,·like "A Beautiful Mind," anattempttobringscienceintoperson- al focus, to look behind the numbers and the equations at precisely how the mathematical mind works, and how very easily it can be broken.
